exchanges.response_text:
[[columns]]
name = "customer_id"
type = "Int64"
nullable = false
description = "Primary key uniquely identifying each customer."

[[columns]]
name = "email"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Customer email address."

[[columns]]
name = "country"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Country associated with the customer."

[[columns]]
name = "signup_date"
type = "Date"
nullable = false
description = "Date the customer signed up."

[[columns]]
name = "referral_code"
type = "String"
nullable = true
description = "Referral code associated with the customer."

[rules]
required = ["customer_id"]
protected = ["customer_id"]
